create_HardUpsampling: create a HardUpsampling module to upsample sequences deterministically using integer durations
create_GaussianUpsampling: create a GaussianUpsampling module to upsample sequences with Gaussian attention-based interpolation
build_VariancePredictor: build a VariancePredictor with conv layers, layer norm, and optional FiLM conditioning for duration/pitch/energy prediction
run_VarianceAdaptor: run a VarianceAdaptor to predict variance features and upsample sequences with duration control
test_VarianceAdaptor_forward: test the VarianceAdaptor forward method with duration, pitch, energy predictors and length regulation
